usage: The renderer picks a palette at random when --palette is not given, which is the default for classroom work. Pass --palette KEY to force one. The first colour in the ramp is the strongest and is used for the first / reference series.

blue-mist-mocha.name: 蓝雾摩卡
blue-mist-mocha.note: Current MA7 house style. The only palette to reach for when the chart must match the existing deck.

sunset.name: 暮橘霞粉
sunset.note: Warm, gender-neutral pastels. Good for paired comparisons.

peach-mist.name: 霁桃云岫
peach-mist.note: Very soft; best for small group counts.

pear-breeze.name: 金梨薄岚
pear-breeze.note: Sunny and light. Use for positive findings.

pine-ceramic.name: 松烟月陶
pine-ceramic.note: Earthy green and beige. Use for environmental or wellness data.

berry-mist.name: 紫莓潮雾
berry-mist.note: Cool, gentle berry tones. Good for academic posters.

twilight-gold.name: 暮光紫金
twilight-gold.note: Formal and elegant. The most paper-like of the warm set.

sea-mist-coral.name: 海雾粉橙
sea-mist-coral.note: High contrast warm and cool. Best when one group must stand out.

contrast-cream-blue.name: 撞色：奶油蓝
contrast-cream-blue.note: Clean two-tone; adapted from the paint-card image.

contrast-blush-navy.name: 撞色：柔光海军
contrast-blush-navy.note: Strong contrast for a keynote slide.

slate-mauve.name: 石板藕紫
slate-mauve.note: From a single-cell UMAP legend. Slate navy plus mauve; calm, scientific, reads well in print.

journal-blue-ember.name: 刊蓝焜橙
journal-blue-ember.note: A five-step cool-to-warm ramp from a marker-expression figure. Use for an ordered series or a colour scale, not for unrelated groups.

amber-lilac.name: 琥珀雪青
amber-lilac.note: Eight colours alternating deep purple, amber and powder blue. The one to reach for when a chart genuinely needs many series.

harbour-ochre.name: 港湾赭青
harbour-ochre.note: Slate blue, pale blue, sand, coral, olive. Crisp and slightly retro; good for grouped bars.

indigo-blossom.name: 靛蓝花信
indigo-blossom.note: Deep indigo through lilac to blossom pink. Reads as a gradient; nice for line and area charts.

lagoon-apricot.name: 潟湖杏绿
lagoon-apricot.note: Teal, apricot, leaf green, sand. Fresh and bright without being loud.

magenta-teal.name: 品红松石
magenta-teal.note: The boldest of the set. Magenta against teal, so two-series charts separate instantly.

candy-pastel.name: 糖果薄彩
candy-pastel.note: Violet, sky, butter yellow, blush, aqua. The friendliest palette; good for a first lesson.
